invariants.rule: Every registered Network Element has one immutable internal identity, nonblank operational name and exactly one authoritative Site.
Device Reference remains the operational identity even after regularization; resolving it to a Network Element never replaces historical SR/RFC/Task/Inventory relationships.
Network Element identity is not established by model, serial, IP, hostname, Rack, Cloud, containment parent, workbook row or other descriptive similarity.
Physical placement chain is Site -> Room -> Rack; Rack derives exactly one Site through its Room.
Any Network Element Rack placement and Cloud Deployment assignment must resolve to the same authoritative Site as the Network Element.
Rack row/column/position are placement semantics, not entity identity, and corrections preserve placement history.
Containment is a one-parent acyclic forest and is independent from Rack placement, Cloud assignment, model compatibility, IP inventory and connectivity.
Cloud Type is reusable reference knowledge; Cloud Deployment is an independently identified Site-scoped instance; a Network Element has at most one current Deployment.
A Network Element may have zero-many descriptive IP addresses with at most one accepted primary; absence/duplication/similarity of IP does not establish identity or topology.
Reusable Model/BOM/component compatibility data and actual installed Component-instance identity/history are separate authorities and cannot overwrite one another.
Installed Component history belongs to the physical Network Element instance and preserves instance-specific slot/serial/chronology facts when known.
Beta 1.0 has no canonical interface, connectivity, reachability, discovery, topology or SSH domain model; no other Infrastructure fact may imply one.
Reusable device/authentication secrets never persist in ordinary Infrastructure/domain/evidence/audit/log/Notes/IP/workbook state.
Infrastructure workbook imports stage and review before mutation; blank/omitted optional cells are non-destructive by default and source workbooks are never modified.
Terminal ticket history does not freeze later Device Reference regularization or Infrastructure correction; those actions never reopen or rewrite the ticket lifecycle.
SQLite remains complete authoritative Infrastructure storage; any graph/index/search representation is a rebuildable projection only.

acceptance_hooks: minimum Network Element registration and later progressive completion
Device Reference regularization after terminal tickets without identity rewrite
same-Site Cloud Deployment and cross-Site rejection
zero/multiple IPs and at-most-one-primary without identity inference
reusable compatibility vs installed Component-instance divergence/history
secret-field rejection and no SSH/device-credential UI
Infrastructure XLSX round-trip staging, omission safety and idempotency
